interpretation_notes: Cora-free prompt does not lock the Planetoid split, so used a dense 60/20/20 stratified split per skill_graph_benchmark_split_and_ensemble. Ensembled 10 seeds of an improved GCN (improved=True, input + hidden dropout 0.5, hidden=64) by averaging log-softmax. Reported metric is accuracy on the 20% holdout.
